title: Inheritance and Witness
author: Jonah Ashgrove
blurb: Dominic Dunmore, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
